decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric still has its own website page and sits close to the core upholstery offer, so management treats it as a visible commitment and attributes modest results to normal market build-up.
The flame-retardant jacquard reflects development investment and serves the contract and hospitality direction the firm has announced, so management persists with it.

The wool bouclé leno is only mentioned rather than featured and resembles the already dropped bouclé and wool-blend items, but its renewable-material fit with the sustainability direction justifies keeping it for now.
The braided-structure fabric was launched only in 2024 with its own page, so management's fresh public commitment and the early market phase strongly favour persistence.
